caption: The drawing features a single horseshoe as the central object, rendered in brown tones with highlights and shadows to give it a three-dimensional appearance. The horseshoe is U-shaped with a slightly flattened and asymmetrical form, and it has eight visible nail holes along its curved edges. At the top of the horseshoe, there is an extended section with a circular hole, possibly for attachment. The main horseshoe is depicted on a plain, off-white background. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller outline sketch of the horseshoe shown from the top, while in the upper right corner there is a linear side-profile sketch of the horseshoe. Measurements are indicated as “½" to 1"” beside the sketches. The main drawing at the center is labeled "Exact Size" in the lower left corner. The overall composition is organized, with the detailed brown horseshoe dominating the page and the outlined sketches providing additional perspectives and scale.
title: Mule Shoe
